content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSB CSRTI Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the CSB-Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute (CSB CSRTI) based in Mysore, Karnataka, for filling project-based positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post under this notification is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the project component SPR01046MIC Component III.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at CSB CSRTI for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is entirely based on a Walk-in-Interview. Candidates do not need to submit applications online or offline in advance unless specified.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow post is scheduled to be held on 07 October 2026 at the designated institute venue.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master of Science degree in life sciences with a minimum of 55% marks (50% for SC/ST candidates) to be eligible for the position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC, ST, OBC, women, and physically challenged candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs.21,000 plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry a bio-data, two passport-size photographs, original certificates from SSLC, PUC, B.Sc., M.Sc., proof of date of birth, experience and caste certificates, along with self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the interview location?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at the CSB-Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute office located in Mysore, Karnataka, with the pincode 570008.
